text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a tenant hit a sudden quota spike after we flipped implicit-v2 routing for them. Looks like requests routed to v2 had higher token usage. Can we discuss quick mitigations?

maria: Ugh. Do we have an example request/headers from the tenant?

alex: Pasted from logs — anonymized: `POST /chat`, path `/v1/chat/completions`, headers: `x-api-version:` (empty), `Prefer-Version: v2` (set by proxy), tenant-id: t-42.

maria: OK that matches a known corner: our header precedence logic treats empty header as "no explicit version" and then implicit opt-in can push to v2. But billing token estimator still used v1 model for that tenant in the ledger.

ian: Right — two separate systems: routing/runtime picks v2-compatible runtime, billing/token-estimator uses tenant's billing-profile which was still v1-mode. That mismatch can under- or overcharge and shows as quota spikes.

sasha: UX note — console toggles are too binary. We need a "preview impact" before making a global routing preference change. Show estimated token delta and estimated $ delta for last 30 days traffic.

pm-lee: SLA/ops question — if we route more to v2, do we expect latency or GPU pressure changes? tenants could see perf regressions. Need to communicate if we flip routing.

maria: Immediate mitigation: add a tenant override to force path-first routing for t-42: `tenant.routing.version_preference = "path_first"` so requests that include v1 path stay on v1. I'll open a quick patch.

alex: Thanks. Also can we add a short-term billing guard: if runtime reports token_count_diff > 10% vs estimator for a tenant, pause auto-routing for that tenant?

ian: We can. Propose telemetry + alert: per-tenant `version_switch_rate`, `token_delta_1h`, and `billing_mismatch_count`. Alert if token_delta_1h > 10% for 5m. I'll add to dashboard.

maria: Deploying routing patch now (canary 10% for that tenant override).

deploy-bot: deploy triggered for routing-config by maria at 6290012360 — canary 10% -> success on 1/1 canary host.

ops-oncall: seeing the spike in quota reports too, thanks for the heads-up. We'll hold any escalations until we see telemetry.

sasha: Console UX follow-up: small modal when changing default routing with these fields: [estimated token delta %, est monthly $ change, sample affected tenants list, opt-in checkbox]. If user applies "soft pin" then runtime routes but billing/profile not changed until confirmation.

pm-lee: Good. Action items: (1) tenant override applied (maria) (2) telemetry panels + alert (ian) (3) add soft-pin UX spec + mock (sasha) (4) runbook entry for routing->billing mismatches (alex). Owners and ETA: maria/ian/sasha/alex — EOD tomorrow.

alex: I'll draft the runbook snippet and include the `curl` checks to validate routing header precedence. Example:
```
curl -H "x-api-version:" -H "Prefer-Version: v2" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages": [...]}' -v
```

maria: pushed the one-off override and added a metric tag for tenant=t-42.

ian: added dashboard panels to staging: `version_switch_rate`, `token_delta_30m`, `billing_mismatch_alerts`. Hooked alert to slack #incidents with severity=low for now.

sasha: I'll open the UX PR with screenshots for the modal. Won't change behavior until we have telemetry.

pm-lee: Thanks team. If numbers look stable by tomorrow morning we can consider a small rollout. Otherwise hold.

alex: tagging @ops-oncall and @pm-lee for visibility :thumbsup: 

maria: closing loop — please ping here if you see another tenant hit the same pattern.
